verdicts.why: In Quantumania Hope challenges Janet over her secrets ('Then make me trust you!'); after Janet tells her about Kang, Hope comforts her: 'you are not alone now. We'll stop him together.'
Restored by the Blip, Hope meets Scott in the Battle of Earth ('We're on it, Cap'), shrinks and carries him to Luis' van to start the tunnel, and stands with him, Hank and Janet at Stark's funeral.
Hope arrives and helps Scott through the probability storm in the core, returns through the portal when Kang attacks him, and the two throw Kang into the power core; then they say 'I love you'.

value.title: Thor: Love and Thunder
value.text: Korg's telling of Thor's life begins with Frigga carrying her baby son into battle.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Frigga's son, whom she carries into battle as a baby.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Thor's mother, who carries him into battle as a baby.

verdicts.why: Korg's recap opens with new flashback footage of Frigga carrying baby Thor into battle. A real flashback counts under the rules, so the two are shown together in this title.

value.title: Captain America: Civil War
value.text: Tony learns from old footage that his father did not die in an accident: the Winter Soldier murdered him and Tony's mother in 1991.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Howard's son, who learns his father was murdered.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Tony's father, murdered by the Winter Soldier in 1991.

verdicts.why: The B.A.R.F. scene is a holographic illusion and doesn't count. But the real 1991 footage of Howard's murder, which Zemo shows Tony, is a real flashback of Howard's death, and his death is a stage.
Jane resents Thor's two-year absence, he takes her to Asgard when the Aether enters her, and her team helps him defeat Malekith at the Greenwich Convergence.
Slingshot episode 1.03: Fitz and Simmons, a couple since S3, upgrade Yo-Yo's watch and do her physical assessment and Inhuman registration in the lab.

#123 is S6#13 'New Life', and the tie has no stage there under either name. Barricaded in a room as the Chronicoms attack, Fitz and Simmons prepare to sacrifice themselves, until a disguised Enoch saves them and offers a plan.

In 'AKA Everything' Luke waits at Jessica's door and tells her that sending his brother Willis Stryker to the Raft was right, though it hurt. He hopes she does the same with Trish and trusts her to do what she must.
Maggie and Paxton pick Cassie up at Scott's house. When the FBI bursts in and rechecks his monitor, Maggie calls it harassment and Paxton says it isn't, that the agents are doing their jobs.
Muneeba fights the Kree in the Khan home (lamp, vase). At the S.A.B.E.R. bay she tells Kamala she'll let her go but never really let her go, and Kamala leaves with Carol and Monica.
Yusuf asks whether Captain Marvel is pressuring Kamala. At S.A.B.E.R. he and Muneeba voice their worry, then let her go.
In 'The H Word' Matt and Karen, now a reporter, have coffee. They discuss his life as Daredevil, which he has given up, and she congratulates him on the Aaron James case.
Maggie tells Scott the family is proud of him and how much he has changed. When his house arrest ends, she opens her door and the family runs out to hug him.
In 'Take Shelter' the Defenders' loved ones gather at the precinct, where Trish and Malcolm gossip about Karen and Foggy.

In The Defenders#8 Matt is under Midland Circle and Karen grieves with Foggy, so the two never deal with each other there. Her refusal to believe he died is already in the Daredevil S3#6 stage, and the #1 stage covers the title.

value.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6#6
value.text: Captured by the Chronicoms, Fitz and Jemma are trapped together inside their own minds, where Fitz learns that his other self died. After a fight they make up, and Enoch frees them.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Jemma's husband, back at her side as a Chronicom prisoner.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Fitz's wife, who tells him how his other self died.

verdicts.why: There is a clear sourced reunion: Simmons surrenders to the Chronicoms to reach Fitz in S6#5, and in S6#6 'Inescapable' they are trapped in their minds together. There Fitz learns his other self died, and after an argument they reconcile before Enoch frees them. The tie has no S6#6 (#116) stage.
Mantis goes with Quill to Knowhere and Titan after Gamora and holds Thanos down, until Quill's attack on learning of Gamora's death breaks her hold. She turns to dust while helping Quill to his feet.
Strange tells Mantis, Quill and the others five years have passed and portals them to the battle. Afterwards the Guardians pick up Thor in New Asgard on the Benatar.
At Indigarr, Mantis and Star-Lord go to the meditating Thor to ask for help, then return to the battle together.
Mantis worries about her brother and has Drax deliver her advice to him. At the end Quill says he is going back to Earth and Mantis leaves to find what she wants.
May helps Peter prepare for the homecoming dance (suit, tie, dancing), and days later walks in on him in his Spider-Man suit.
Restored by the Blip, May attends Tony Stark's funeral together with Peter.
May hugs Peter as he packs, puts his suit in his suitcase, and greets him at Newark airport when he returns.
Peter regularly visits May's grave. Jean experiences his real memory of May saying she loves him for who he is, and at May's grave he vows to stop doing everything alone.
In S7#2 'Know Your Onions' May wakes healed and fights Enoch. The Coulson LMD stops her, and she says he is not Coulson, since Coulson is still dead. They work together through S7.
In the Kree attack Muneeba plants her body over the knocked-down Yusuf. The Khans go with Fury to the S.A.B.E.R. station.
Odin warns of the Aether and won't let Jane or the fight leave Asgard. After Frigga's death, Thor defies him, freeing Loki and taking Jane off Asgard.
Peggy dies in her sleep, and Steve serves as a pallbearer at her funeral, where Sharon gives the eulogy.
Pepper gets Tony to read Coulson's files and help S.H.I.E.L.D. Before flying the nuke into space he tries to call her, and she misses the call on her plane.
Killian kidnaps Pepper and gives her Extremis, and she kills him to save Tony. Tony destroys his suits for her and has the shrapnel removed.
